question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}2&-1&3\\4&0&5\\1&2&6\end{bmatrix}$, determine the minor $M_{23}$.
explanation:
Step 1: Identify the required position
The minor $M_{23}$ corresponds to the element in the second row and third column.
Step 2: Delete the corresponding row and column
Deleting the second row and third column of $A$ leaves the determinant $$M_{23}=\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\1&2\end{vmatrix}$$
Step 3: Evaluate the determinant
Using $\begin{vmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{vmatrix}=ad-bc$, $$M_{23}=(2)(2)-(-1)(1)$$
Step 4: Simplify
Thus, $$M_{23}=4+1=5$$
Hence, the required minor is $M_{23}=5$.
